security_and_recovery.dashboard_replacement: The public PUT route replaces the existing dashboard definition through the real SQLite semantic store; the earlier route returned HTTP 500 for a changed definition because it used create-only conflict semantics. The fix adds an explicit replacement operation while preserving create conflicts.
security_and_recovery.filtered_query_identity: The dashboard filter is evaluated against an independent Parquet fixture through project-scoped DuckDB and returns the expected grouped value ES=5; the test does not fabricate the result.
security_and_recovery.negative_paths: An empty semantic filter value returns HTTP 400 with invalid_request; the existing full local suite also retains tile-budget, workspace-scope and Bundle-digest negative coverage.
security_and_recovery.workspace_scope: The real local composition uses the configured bearer token and workspace-scoped authorizer; prior D29 coverage denies unknown semantic workspaces with HTTP 403 and remains in the candidate full local suite.
security_and_recovery.recovery: The replaced dashboard and filtered query result survive a full local composition restart; the independent Parquet fixture remains readable.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: Only the local SQLite semantic store, local DuckDB SQL engine and local Parquet fixture were exercised. PostgreSQL semantic persistence/import, external warehouse/provider serving, cancellation/fan-out operational rehearsal and complete P10 certification were not run and are not claimed.
